title: [Chapitre] VI. Analysis situs (deuxième mouture) : notes manuscrites (18-20/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. This is the 1986 'Analysis situs (deuxième mouture)'. Grothendieck is building an axiomatic, combinatorial framework for 'tame' spaces. Its vocabulary is: ateliers, stations, dalles, figures, lieux. The basic data are as follows.
- M is a set of 'figures' (lieux).
- X ≪ Y means X is a refinement (subdivision) of Y.
- X̃ is the ordered set of pieces of X.
- X ∩ Y is the infimum K of two figures, with K̃ = X̃ ∩ Ỹ.
- X'_K is the refinement of K induced by a refinement X' ≪ X.
- A binary relation (written ≷, or crossed ≫ on the page) means that two figures are compatible, i.e. have no bad overlap. This is the notion attached to the 'critères de compatibilité/disjonction'.

At 12 (finished on this page). Let X' ≪ X and Y' ≪ Y with X and Y compatible, and let K = X ∩ Y. If the induced refinements X'_K and Y'_K are compatible, then X' and Y' are compatible.

Equivalent pointwise form. If every piece X'' ∈ X̃' with X'' ≪ K (equivalently X'' ≪ Y) is compatible with every piece Y'' ∈ Ỹ' with Y'' ≪ K (equivalently Y'' ≪ X), then X' and Y' are compatible. In words: compatibility of refinements can be tested on the overlap. This is a local-to-global compatibility condition analogous to checking that two subdivisions agree on the intersection of their supports.

What At 12 implies. Grothendieck notes it implies:
- At 11' (the renamed, slightly weakened gluing axiom);
- At 10;
- the proposition of p. 73.
Hence it also gives At 11 (gluing of loci) for finite families F̃, and Cor. 2 of p. 69 for finite index sets.

Re-organisation of the axioms. He observes that the following are intimately entangled by various implications:
- At 9: criterion of disjunction by the loci;
- At 9' and At 9'': compatibility criteria;
- At 10;
- At 11 / At 11': gluing;
- At 12: compatibility by intersections.
He proposes to subsume them, starting with 9' and 9'', under the notion of a Σ-atelier. Here Σ is a full subcategory of the category of ordered sets. An atelier is a Σ-atelier if (i) for every X ∈ M, X̃ ∈ Σ, and (ii) it satisfies Ax 9_Σ, stated on the next page. Ax 9_Σ says that X and Y are compatible iff (i) the shadows outside K are pairwise compatible and (ii) K̃ ∈ Σ. Varying Σ then interpolates between the old 9' (Σ = all ordered sets) and 9'' (Σ = Σ_M, i.e. K ∈ M).

Purpose. This is axiom engineering for a combinatorial or o-minimal-style foundation of 'topologie modérée'.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The finiteness restrictions are explicitly flagged: At 11 is obtained only for finite F̃, and Cor. 2 of p. 69 only for finite index sets. This leaves open the infinite case, which Grothendieck strikes through without resolving.
The claim that At 12 implies At 10, At 11' and the prop. of p. 73 is asserted without proof on this page.

ideas.what: At 12: compatibility of two refinements X' ≪ X, Y' ≪ Y is detected by compatibility of their induced refinements on K = X ∩ Y (equivalently, piecewise on the pieces lying in K)
ideas.modern_name: local (overlap) criterion for compatibility of subdivisions / common refinement on intersections, akin to the gluing of cell decompositions in o-minimal or PL topology
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore in PL topology and o-minimal cell decomposition (van den Dries et al.); no specific axiomatisation of this form
ideas.where_published: Only the general programme of 'topologie modérée' appears, in Esquisse d'un programme §5; these axioms do not

ideas.what: Unification of the axioms on disjunction, compatibility and gluing via 'Σ-ateliers', parametrised by a full subcategory Σ of ordered sets
ideas.modern_name: axiomatics of a poset-indexed class of 'tame' figures; loosely, a combinatorial site with a chosen class of admissible shapes

missed.claim: An axiom system for 'ateliers' (combinatorial tame spaces) in which disjunction, compatibility and gluing of figures are unified by a single parametrised axiom Ax 9_Σ. The infinite case of the gluing axiom remains unresolved.
missed.quote: je vais d'abord ... quant à At 9' et At 9'', par la notion de Σ-atelier, où Σ est une sous-cat. pleine de la cat. des ens. ordonnés
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a concrete, unstudied piece of Grothendieck's tame-topology foundations. It could be compared with o-minimal structures, stratified spaces and combinatorial models (posets of cells, exit-path categories). Its significance is modest without the surrounding definitions.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is internal axiom bookkeeping within an unpublished foundation of tame topology. The Σ-atelier unification is mildly interesting but technical and not clearly a novel result.
transcription_corrections: The first word is likely 'posé' ('Ceci posé, si ...'), continuing 'Ceci' from p. 76, rather than 'pour'.
Lines 'reliés entre eux, par des implications diverses' and 'Σ-Atelier, où Σ est une sous-cat. pleine' are duplicated in the machine transcription.
The phrase is likely 'Mais que je résume dans une formulation commune, je vais d'abord [donner] quant à At 9' et At 9''', i.e. 'quant à' rather than 'qui à'.
Item (i) reads '∀X ∈ M, X̃ ∈ Σ' (the X is struck and rewritten).
'Les axiomes At 9 (critère de disjonction premier par les lieux)': 'premier' is an interlinear insertion.
Margin (rotated): 'dans ce qui suit faire At N°?'.
